title: Children and Parents, The Whole Armor of God

questions.question: Children, ____ your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:1 (ESV): "Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right."

questions.question: "Honor your father and mother" (this is the first commandment with a ____),
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:2 (ESV): "'Honor your father and mother' (this is the first commandment with a promise),"

questions.question: Fathers, do not provoke your children to ____, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:4 (ESV): "Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord."

questions.question: Bondservants (slaves), obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling, with a sincere heart, as you would ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:5 (ESV): "Bondservants, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling, with a sincere heart, as you would Christ,"

questions.question: Masters, do the same to them, and stop your ____, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and that there is no partiality with him.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:9 (ESV): "Masters, do the same to them, and stop your threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and that there is no partiality with him."

questions.question: Finally, be ____ in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:10 (ESV): "Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might."

questions.question: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the ____ of the devil.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:11 (ESV): "Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil."

questions.question: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:12 (ESV): "For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness..."

questions.question: Stand therefore, having fastened on the belt of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:14 (ESV): "Stand therefore, having fastened on the belt of truth,"

questions.question: ...and having put on the breastplate of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:14 (ESV): "...and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,"

questions.question: ...and, as shoes for your feet, having put on the readiness given by the gospel of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:15 (ESV): "and, as shoes for your feet, having put on the readiness given by the gospel of peace."

questions.question: In all circumstances take up the shield of ____, with which you can extinguish all the flaming darts of the evil one.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:16 (ESV): "In all circumstances take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming darts of the evil one;"

questions.question: And take the helmet of ____, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:17 (ESV): "and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,"

questions.question: What is the sword of the Spirit?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:17 (ESV): "and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,"

questions.question: Who did Paul send to them so that they may know how Paul is, and that he may encourage their hearts?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 6:21-22 (ESV): "So that you also may know how I am and what I am doing, Tychicus the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord will tell you everything. I have sent him to you for this very purpose..."

key_verse_text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might. Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil.
